claim_text: | File | What it does | |------|-------------| | `coordinator.py` | Wake up, select tensor, dispatch scout/scour, collect response | | `model_selector.py` | Cost-weighted random walk across OpenRouter's model catalog | | `scout.py` | Send a tensor to a model, get a response, write it to cairn | | `scourer.py` | Targeted exploration with 3 scope types: introspection (project internals), external (other codebases), tensor (cairn analysis).
